annotations.text:
DIRECTION: Printed transit ephemera.

Ink slabs, hard edges, zero rounded pills, zero frosted glass. Numbers read as split-flap departure-board cells. The ticket stub is the only warm surface.

Type: Bahnschrift / DIN Alternate (display) + Cascadia Mono (data). Both ship with the OS, so the game stays fully offline.

Ink #0d1017 - Paper #f1ebdd - Signal #ff4a17 - Live #5ce9c9 - Gold #ffc23d
Two directions I did not take, kept for comparison. Both are low-fi sketches, not built out.
